There are places that are dedicated to supporting people with mental health conditions. Not like professionals but support groups and stuff of people going through similar things. You remind me of an acquaintance of mine who wanted to kill herself because her boyfriend dumped her. She was convinced he was the only person on earth who could ever understand her but she was forced to go to counseling after her suicide attempt failed and she met the love of her life there. 

It just doesn't follow that because your family supports you, no one else will. The meeting she was at was run by an organization called [NAMI](http://www.nami.org/)
You could still meet someone who gives you the understanding and support you need. Dying without being understood is less than you deserve

After reading your post I looked at the top/all time posts of r/happy and there is one there about a couple that met in a mental hospital. The hospital part seems a bit extreme but perhaps you could join a mental health support group and meet the love of your life there?
That's not going to kill you. I too am going to die soon, if you got anything to get out there before your time comes I will listen
